title: Porter Lodge
shortDescription: A ticking kettle keeps company with a regiment of labelled keys.
longDescription:
A black stove warms a room barely wider than its collection of coats. The kettle mutters to itself, and a chair holds a cushion shaped by many years of well-earned sitting.
Keys hang from a numbered board beside a parcel shelf. A brass whistle lies on the desk under a note: 'Spare. The other one is probably around my neck.'

fixtures.name: Key Board
fixtures.examineDescription: Each hook has a neat label. One reads 'Spare key to spare-key cupboard', followed by a smaller, firmer note: 'Do not put this INSIDE the spare-key cupboard.' The lowest hooks are empty, ready for new Collegians' beginnings.
